name: St Andrews & Fife
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) brings the best weather and the busiest golf season; winter is cold, grey, and quiet, like the rest of eastern Scotland.
overview: The Old Course at St Andrews, where golf has been played since the 15th century, paired with Fife's fishing villages — golf's most significant pilgrimage site.
costOverview: Fife's fishing villages are affordable for food — a tee time on the Old Course itself, allocated by ballot rather than just paid for, is the one legendary splurge.

costItems.label: Old Course tee time, advance ballot
